run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-17T07:28:42Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert for otel-demo/frontend-proxy is explained by HTTP 500s on its 'ingress' spans: the ingress error-span rate was 0.01-0.03/s from 06:30 to 07:28, then stepped to 0.40/s at the 07:29 sample and 0.66-0.74/s through 07:42, while total ingress span rate stayed ~14-16/s. The 500s carry error text 'shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500' and propagate checkout -> frontend -> frontend-proxy. In the same traces the visible failing dependency edge is shipping's client span 'POST quote' (to quote:8080) ending after ~5.0s with otel.status_description 'Timeout', so shipping's '/get-quote' returns 'Internal Server Error'. Shipping pod logs show repeated 'Requesting quote' without 'Sending Quote', and the quote pod logs 'Calculated quote' only in short bursts at 07:36:31-32, 07:37:31-32 and 07:38:31 - the recovery instants of a repeating chaos experiment. In chaos-mesh, the Schedule 'otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition' spawned new NetworkChaos objects every minute from 07:28:36 (first 6 s before the alert fired), and the NetworkChaos Applied events target only otel-demo/quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w and otel-demo/shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv. All otel-demo pods, including quote, shipping, email, frontend and frontend-proxy, were Running/Ready with 0 restarts (started 06:51). Email's sampled server spans returned 200 and the per-service error query returned no email ERROR series, so email is not shown to be the failing server despite the error text; email pod logs could not be read. Whether the fault continued past the available data (metrics end ~07:42, sampled traces ~07:40, newest event 07:38:04) and the exact chaos parameters are unresolved, so the conclusion is partial.

claims.text: frontend-proxy 'ingress' error-rate rose from a 0.011-0.033/s baseline (06:30-07:28) to 0.40/s at the 07:29 sample, 0.689/s at 07:30 and 0.67-0.744/s through 07:42, while the UNSET ingress span rate stayed ~14-16/s; the alert fired at 07:28:42.

The frontend-proxy error spans are HTTP 500s: 'ingress' spans with error=true, http.status_code=500, otel.status_code=ERROR whose child frontend spans are 'POST /api/checkout' 500 and 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' 500, with checkout PlaceOrder failing with rpc.grpc.status_code=13.

The failing dependency edge visible in the traces is shipping to quote: shipping's '/get-quote' span returned 'Internal Server Error' and its child client span 'POST quote' ended after ~5.001s with otel.status_description 'Timeout' (also 5.0006-5.0013 s in three further traces between 07:39 and 07:41).

The error text propagated to frontend/checkout is exactly '13 INTERNAL: shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500' (checkout PlaceOrder otel.status_description 'shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500').

shipping pod logs between 07:37:27 and 07:38:41 show repeated 'Requesting quote' lines with no following 'Sending Quote'/'Tracking ID Created', except a burst of successful 'Sending Quote'/'Tracking ID Created' pairs at 07:37:31 and 07:38:31.
quote pod logs 07:36:30-07:39:00 contain 'Calculated quote' only at 07:36:31-32, 07:37:31-32 and 07:38:31 (the moments each NetworkChaos experiment recovered), with no quote calculations in between.

chaos-mesh Schedule 'otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition' recorded 'Create new object: otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition-<suffix>' Spawned events every minute from 07:28:36 through 07:37:36 (07:28:36, 07:29:36, 07:30:36, 07:31:36, 07:32:36, 07:33:36, 07:34:36, 07:35:36, 07:36:36, 07:37:36).

NetworkChaos events show 'Experiment has started' at 07:28:36 and 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w' and 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv' at 07:28:36, with 'Time up according to the duration' and 'Successfully recover chaos' at 07:29:31, repeating each minute; resolving all 20 Applied messages yields only those two pod names (quote and shipping).

Per-service ERROR-status span rates show the same onset: checkout 0.533/s at 07:30 then 1.36-1.47/s, shipping 0.533/s at 07:30 then 0.75-1.49/s, frontend 1.51/s at 07:30 then 1.45-3.02/s, frontend-proxy 0.789/s at 07:30 then 0.75-1.49/s; payment and accounting returned 0 throughout 06:30-07:42, and the query returned no email ERROR series (email appeared only as STATUS_CODE_UNSET).
Sampled email server spans ('POST /send_order_confirmation', with child 'send_email' and 'sinatra.render_template') recorded http.status_code=200 between 07:37:31 and 07:38:31.

All 21 otel-demo pods were Running and Ready with 0 restarts and start times ~06:51, including quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w, shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv, email-59f69bc6cf-8z5c5, frontend-675fd7b5c5-kgxrg and frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-wvxht.

Deployment env shows shipping's only downstream quote address QUOTE_ADDR=http://quote:8080, while checkout has SHIPPING_ADDR=http://shipping:8080 and EMAIL_ADDR=http://email:8080; email's own container exposes EMAIL_PORT=8080.

At 07:45 the 5-minute frontend-proxy 'ingress' rate was still 0.183/s STATUS_CODE_ERROR versus 3.457/s STATUS_CODE_UNSET, i.e. errors were still elevated in the last available metric window (metric samples end ~07:42).

A second, smaller frontend-proxy error mode exists: 'ingress' spans returned http.status_code 503 at 07:35:13.6, 07:35:13.6, 07:36:15.6, 07:38:06.9 and 07:38:00.4, each with a child 'router frontend egress' span carrying error="true" and http.status_code="0" and no frontend server span in the trace.

The NetworkChaos objects spawned by the chaos-mesh Schedule 'otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition' (applied only to the quote and shipping pods, first started 07:28:36) are the fault that blocked shipping-to-quote traffic, producing the ~5.0 s 'POST quote' timeouts, shipping 500s, checkout PlaceOrder failures and the frontend-proxy ingress 500s; the quote pod receiving work only at each chaos Recovery instant is consistent with this, but the NetworkChaos spec (selector/target/direction/latency-loss parameters) could not be read.

The error text names an 'email service' 500, but no email span with http.status_code=500 was found (the tag search returned no traces) and the sampled email server spans returned 200; therefore the evidence does not show the email service itself as the failing server.

Because the propagated error text specifically says a POST to the email service got 500, an additional email-path fault cannot be excluded; the email container produced no readable log lines (current instance 0 lines, previous instance unavailable), so its internal state during the incident remains unverified.

The frontend-proxy 503s (router frontend egress http.status_code=0, no frontend server span) are a separate failure mode whose cause is not established by the sampled traces; the frontend pod was Running/Ready with 0 restarts and its container produced no readable log lines, so this remains an open candidate rather than part of the shipping/quote explanation.

A crash or restart of frontend-proxy itself is not the cause: the frontend-proxy pod frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-wvxht was Running/Ready with 0 restarts since 06:51, and its error spans are 500 responses propagated from frontend/checkout rather than proxy-process failures.

Inspect and, if it is not intended, stop/delete the chaos-mesh Schedule 'otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition' and read its NetworkChaos spec (selector, target, direction, duration, delay/loss) to confirm which pod pairs are partitioned; the events show chaos applied to quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w and shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv every minute from 07:28:36.

Confirm the exact meaning of the 'failed POST to email service' message in checkout/shipping code and verify email service behavior with a readable log source, since email pod logs were empty and email spans sampled at the recovery instants returned 200.

gaps: chaos-mesh custom resources (Schedule 'otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition' and its NetworkChaos spawns) could not be read as objects; only Kubernetes events are available, so the experiment's selector, target, direction and delay/loss parameters are unknown.
list_prometheus_rules returned no rules both with rule_name=RequestErrorRate and unfiltered, so the alert's exact expression and evaluation window are unknown.

Email pod logs could not be read: the current email container returned 0 lines and the previous instance was unavailable, so email's internal 5xx behavior is unverified; the tag search for email spans with http.status_code=500 returned no traces.

Metric samples end ~07:42 and sampled trace data ends ~07:40 while the newest event is 07:38:04, so whether the error rate and the chaos Schedule continued after those times is unknown; the 07:45 5-minute rate (0.183/s) only shows errors were still elevated inside the available data.
Why the propagated error text names 'email service' while the visible failing edge in the same traces is shipping->quote is unresolved.
The cause of the frontend-proxy 503 error mode (no frontend server span, router egress http.status_code=0) is not determined.
No change_history integration is available in this Run, so deployment/config changes cannot be correlated.
next_steps: Read the chaos-mesh Schedule 'otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition' and one of its NetworkChaos children to confirm the targeted pod pairs and the fault type (partition vs delay/loss) and duration.
Obtain frontend-proxy/Envoy access logs or metrics broken down by response code to separate the 500 checkout-path errors from the 503/no-upstream errors.
If the email-service suspicion must be resolved, enable/collect email container logs and check email request logs for 5xx responses between 07:28 and 07:42.
Review the alert rule definition for RequestErrorRate in the alerting Prometheus that generated the Alertmanager alert, since the target Prometheus returned no rules.
